name: Tigris MCP
description: Manages Tigris object storage from AI agents: create buckets, read and write objects, share presigned URLs, and snapshot or fork buckets. For developers storing app and agent data.

skills.name: Manage Buckets
skills.description: Creates, lists, inspects and deletes Tigris buckets, including new buckets with snapshots enabled, from an agent session.

skills.name: Manage Objects
skills.description: Lists, reads, writes and deletes objects in a Tigris bucket and looks up their metadata, such as saving a summary file.

skills.name: Share Presigned URLs
skills.description: Creates presigned URLs so a browser, a person or another system can download or upload an object without credentials.

skills.name: Agent Workspaces
skills.description: Creates a dedicated bucket for an agent with an optional expiry and scoped credentials, then tears it down when work is done.

skills.name: Checkpoints & Forks
skills.description: Snapshots a bucket, restores a snapshot into an independent bucket, and creates copy-on-write forks for parallel agents.
